cypherpunk.phrase: PRIVACY IS THE POWER TO REVEAL YOURSELF SELECTIVELY

capsule.title: THE RIGHT TO SELECT
capsule.body: Privacy is not disappearance. It is the power to decide which version of yourself crosses a boundary.

capsule.title: MINIMUM NECESSARY
capsule.body: I am interested in proofs that replace disclosure: systems where a fact can be verified without turning a person into a record.

capsule.title: INTELLIGENCE THAT FORGETS
capsule.body: The useful agent is not the one that remembers everything. It is the one whose memory remains legible, revocable, and owned by the user.
capsule.trace: LOCAL INFERENCE / EPHEMERAL MEMORY / USER-HELD KEY

final.title: I BUILD TO REMOVE UNNECESSARY TRUST.
final.body: My work sits where private AI, cryptographic guarantees, and permissionless infrastructure meet. I care less about making systems appear trustworthy than making trust unnecessary, inspectable, and revocable.
frontiers: AI agents whose memory belongs to the user
Zero-knowledge systems that disclose only what a decision requires
Permissionless infrastructure that preserves the right to exit
final.openChannel: PGP / ADD OWNER FINGERPRINT BEFORE DEPLOYMENT
final.finalLine: You learned more without identifying yourself. The protocol held.
